pages.text: The $(bold)DNA Strand$() is the starting point of the strain engineering chain. Extract it from Hemp Seeds using the $(bold)Extractor$() machine.$(br)$(br)A blank DNA Strand must be filled with $(bold)3 specific reagent items$() in the $(bold)Synthesizer$() to create a Filled DNA Strand. The Filled DNA Strand is then processed in the $(bold)Sequencer$() with a Base Extract to produce a specific strain extract.$(br)$(br)The resulting extract goes into the $(bold)Mutator$() with seeds and Hemp Oil to create that strain's seeds.

pages.title: Full DNA Chain
pages.text: $(bold)1.$() Extractor + Hemp Seeds → DNA Strand$(br)$(bold)2.$() Synthesizer + DNA Strand + 3 Reagents → Filled DNA Strand$(br)$(bold)3.$() Sequencer + Filled DNA Strand + Base Extract → Strain Extract$(br)$(bold)4.$() Mutator + Seeds + Strain Extract + Hemp Oil → Strain Seeds$(br)$(br)Check each Strain's guide entry for the exact 3 reagents required for the Synthesizer.
